svg.title: Container view and boundary-crossing data
svg.desc: An operator sends intent and human decisions to a local agent client. A mediated access component receives caller identity and a bounded context request. Persistent domain agents and temporary execution workers are separate runtime principals. A queue receives work identity and lease state. Version control and delivery receive source revisions and artifacts. Memory returns authorized source identity, cutoff, and bounded content. An authorization policy produces an allow, deny, or human-gate decision; a separate credential issuer returns a short-lived capability reference only after approval. External calls carry the authorized operation and capability. Telemetry receives revision, artifact, work, and observed-outcome identity and creates evidence-backed repair work. These are distinct functional and authorization boundaries, not one shared trust zone.
